loaded.title: Loaded models
loaded.intro: Loaded models. Each answers on Temper's API by its name; chat uses the first.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.stop: Stop the reply, or close find
keys.pages: Chat, Models, Library, Train, Datasets, Recipes, Export, Connect
settings.title: Settings
settings.zoom_hint: {mod} + and {mod} − change it anywhere; {mod} 0 resets. {mod} / lists every shortcut.
settings.language_hint: Some pages are still in English while their translations are written.
chat.empty_list: Chats you start are saved here.
chat.private: Everything runs on this computer. Nothing you type leaves it.
chat.loading_hint: Large models can take a minute to load into memory.
chat.load_first: Load a model to start chatting
chat.load_hint: Pick a GGUF model you've downloaded, or find one on Hugging Face.
chat.send_hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.summarising: Summarising earlier messages to fit the context…
chat.stopped_thinking: The model stopped while still thinking. Raise Max new tokens, or set a thinking budget, and regenerate.
chat.queue_hint: Enter to queue it for when the reply finishes
prompts.hint: Saved prompts. Type / in an empty message to find one.
prompts.empty: No prompts yet. Write a message, then save it here to reuse it.
prompts.name: Name
prompts.variables_hint: Write {{name}} for a part to fill in each time.
instr.project_hint: Its AGENTS.md files, from the repository root down, are added to the instructions.
instr.title: Instructions for every chat
instr.global_hint: Saved as AGENTS.md in Temper's folder and sent ahead of each chat's system prompt, followed by the AGENTS.md files of the chat's project folder.
instr.placeholder: For example: Answer in British English. Prefer short answers.
loaded.paused_hint: Unloaded to free the GPU; its context is saved and comes back on resume.
fit.title: This message doesn't fit in the model's context
fit.summary: It needs about {need} tokens with the room kept for the reply; the context holds {context}, so it's {over} over.
fit.none: Nothing simple makes it fit. Send a shorter message.
fit.compact: Turn on auto-compact, so earlier messages ({tokens} tokens) are summarised
fit.new_chat: Start a new chat; earlier messages take {tokens} tokens
fit.shorten_instructions: Shorten the system prompt or AGENTS.md ({tokens} tokens)
fit.longer_context: Reload the model with a context of {to} tokens (it supports up to {max})
tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: The model can call these while it answers. Small models may call them poorly or not at all.
tool.calculator.about: Works out arithmetic exactly, instead of the model guessing.
tool.current_time.about: Tells the model today's date and the time, here or in another time zone.
tools.no_answer: The model stopped after its tool calls without answering. Regenerate, or try a larger model.
tools.waiting: Waiting for you to allow it.
tool.run_python.about: Runs Python code the model writes, in a sandbox, and shows it what it printed.
tool.run_javascript.about: Runs JavaScript with Node.js, in a sandbox, and shows the model what it printed.
tool.run_shell.about: Runs shell commands the model writes, in a sandbox, and shows it their output.
sandbox.title: Code sandbox
sandbox.seatbelt: Code runs in macOS's sandbox: no network, and it can only change its own folder.
sandbox.bubblewrap: Code runs in a bubblewrap sandbox: no network, and it can only change its own folder.
sandbox.none: There's no OS sandbox on this computer: code the model runs can use the network and reach your files. Keep it on Ask first.
sandbox.data_off: Python has its standard library only. Add {packages} (about 300 MB).
sandbox.remove_confirm: Remove the data libraries? Python code goes back to the standard library; you can add them again later.
sandbox.no_node: JavaScript needs Node.js; install it to let models run JavaScript.
sandbox.check_about: Temper tries to get out of it, and shows what held.
sandbox.c.no_secrets: Reading key and credential folders (none here to try)
tools.mcp_about: Its {count} tools, each asking first or running as set in Settings.
mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.about: Tools from Model Context Protocol servers, for chat models to call. Turn a server on for a chat in its Tools.
mcp.empty: No servers yet. Add one, or paste the mcpServers config another app uses.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.command_hint: The command that starts the server, with its arguments.
mcp.env_hint: One KEY=value per line, for API keys and settings.
mcp.headers_hint: One Name: value per line, such as an Authorization header.
mcp.paste_hint: Paste JSON with an mcpServers object, as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code use.
mcp.preset.title: Ready-made
mcp.preset.filesystem_about: Read, search and write files in one folder you choose, and nowhere else.
mcp.preset.github_about: Issues, pull requests, code search and repositories, with a personal access token.
mcp.preset.blender_about: Build and change 3D scenes in a running Blender with the blender-mcp add-on connected.
mcp.preset.pick_folder: Folder the files server can use
skills.title: Skills
skills.empty_picker: No skills yet. Make one in Settings, or add one to the project's .agents/skills.
skills.about: Folders of instructions (SKILL.md) a chat brings in when you mention them, like @write-tests. A project's own skills in .agents/skills or .claude/skills come too.
skills.remove_confirm: Remove the skill {name} and its folder?
skills.name: Name
skills.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; you mention it as @name.
skills.description_hint: Writing unit tests for Python code
tool.read_web_page.about: Reads public web pages and PDFs the model asks for, and their links.
tool.web_search.about: Searches the web for the model, through the provider chosen in Settings.
tool.search_knowledge.about: Searches your own documents in Settings → Knowledge bases, and cites the files it found.
search.title: Web search
search.about: Where the Web search tool sends a model's searches. Only the search words go to the provider, never the chat.
search.searxng: A SearXNG instance you run or trust, with its JSON format turned on.
search.brave: Brave's search API, with your key (it has a free tier).
search.tavily: Tavily's search API for AI agents, with your key (it has a free tier).
search.url_hint: Where your SearXNG instance answers, such as http://localhost:8888.
search.works: {name} works: {count} results for a test search.
research.title: Research
research.about: Ask a question; the loaded model searches the web, reads the sources and writes a report that cites them.
research.ask: What do you want to find out?
research.how: It plans searches, reads each source and notes what bears on your question, then writes a report from those notes alone.
research.placeholder: For example: Which open-weight models under 10B parameters are best at coding right now, and how do they compare?
research.depth.quick_about: 3 searches, up to 5 sources. A few minutes.
research.depth.standard_about: 4 searches and a follow-up round, up to 8 sources.
research.depth.thorough_about: 5 searches and two follow-up rounds, up to 14 sources. Can take a while.
research.needs_model: Research uses the model loaded for chat. Load one on the Models page first.
research.delete_confirm: Delete this research and its report?
research.review_hint: Untick a source to leave it out, then write the report again from the rest.
kb.title: Knowledge bases
kb.about: Folders of your documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Markdown, text and code) that chat models can search with the Knowledge bases tool. Everything stays on this computer.
kb.embedder_hint: Turns passages into vectors so search finds them by meaning. It runs in llama.cpp, apart from chat's model.
kb.needs_llama: Knowledge bases need llama.cpp. Install it from the Models page.
kb.name: Name
kb.delete_confirm: Delete the knowledge base {name}? Your files stay where they are; only the index is removed.
kb.sync_on: Changes in these folders are indexed within a minute. .gitignore rules are honoured.
kb.sync_off: Index changes by hand with the refresh button.
kb.ocr_vision: Scanned PDF pages are read by the vision model loaded for chat.
kb.ocr_tesseract: Scanned PDF pages are read with Tesseract (a vision model loaded for chat reads them better).
kb.ocr_none: Scanned PDF pages are skipped: load a vision model for chat, or install Tesseract, to read them.
kb.urls_hint: One address per line. Web pages are read as text, YouTube videos as their transcript.
kb.add_url: Add a web page or YouTube link

models.search_placeholder: Search models, e.g. qwen, gemma, llama

models.no_match_hint: Try a shorter search or clear the author filter.
models.import_hint: or drop files here. Temper uses them where they are; nothing is copied.
models.path_placeholder: Path to a .gguf file or a model folder
models.ollama_hint: Temper can use these files as they are, with their Modelfile settings; nothing is copied.
models.other_devices_hint: Apps and agents using Temper's API reach these by the name shown; they run on that computer.
models.uses_convert: convert to a GGUF to chat with it
models.uses_both: for fine-tuning and export, or convert to a GGUF to chat with it
models.convert_title: Convert with llama.cpp so chat can load it. The original files stay as they are.
models.delete_confirm: Delete {model}? This frees {size}. You can download it again later.
models.empty: No models on this computer yet
models.empty_hint: Pick one from the Catalog, search under Find models, or import a .gguf file you already have.
models.remove_title: Remove from the library. The files stay where they are.
models.missing_hint: Import it again from its new place, or remove it.
models.parts_found: {n} parts found; put the rest beside it to load it
models.parts_downloaded: {n} parts downloaded; download the rest to load it
models.no_weights: No model weights downloaded, only metadata files.
models.drop: Drop a .gguf file or a model folder to add it to your library

library.code_in_chat: written by code in a chat
library.description: Your uploads, datasets, fine-tunes, exports and converted models, the pictures, speech and stems you make, and files code wrote in chats. Renaming changes the name shown here; files on disk keep theirs.
library.drop: Drop to copy into your library
library.no_match_hint: Try part of the name, or the file's own name.
library.folder_hint: Move files here with the folder menu on each one.
library.favourites_hint: Star a file to keep it here.
library.empty_hint: Datasets you prepare or generate, training runs, exports and converted models appear here. Drop files on this page to add your own.
library.remove_folder_confirm: Remove the folder {name}? The files in it stay in your library.
library.folders_hint: Group files your own way, e.g. by project.
library.name: Name
library.what_run: this training run and its adapter
library.what_export: this export and all its files
